titleInfo.title: This explains everything
titleInfo.subTitle: deep, beautiful, and elegant theories of how the world works

abstract.#text: "Drawn from the cutting-edge frontiers of science, This Explains Everything presents 150 of the most deep, surprising, and brilliant explanations of how the world works, with contributions by Jared Diamond, Richard Dawkins, Nassim Taleb, Brian Eno, Steven Pinker, and more"-- Provided by publisher.
